This is a test file for aiparstxt — a text sanitization tool.

It contains various characters that should be replaced with '?'.

Accented characters: café, naïve, résumé, über, España, São Paulo, Zürich, Ångström.
German umlauts: ä ö ü ß Ä Ö Ü
French: é è ê ë à â ù û î ô ï ç
Spanish: ñ ¿ ¡
Portuguese: ã Ã õ Õ ç Ç
Nordic: å Å æ Æ ø Ø

Typographic quotes: "smart quotes" and 'single quotes'
Long dash: —
Ellipsis: …
Bullet: •
Copyright: ©
Registered: ®
Trademark: ™
Euro: €
Pound: £
Yen: ¥
Cent: ¢

Math: ± × ÷ ≤ ≥ ≠ ∞ ∑ ∏ √ ∫
Fractions: ½ ¼ ¾

Emoji: 😀 🎉 🚀 ❤️ 👍
Chinese: 你好世界
Japanese: こんにちは
Arabic: مرحبا
Hebrew: שלום
Thai: สวัสดี

Latin Extended: đ Đ ł Ł ń Ń ś Ś ź ź ż Ż
Czech: ř č ň ě
Polish: ą ę ś ć ź ż ó

Various symbols: § ¶ ° µ ¬ ¦ ¨ © ª « ¬ ® ¯ ° ± ² ³ ´ µ ¶ · ¸ ¹ º » ¼ ½ ¾ ¿

Some normal text with allowed characters:
Numbers: 0123456789
Latin: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
Russian: АБВГДЕЁЖЗИЙКЛМНОПРСТУФХЦЧШЩЪЫЬЭЮЯ абвгдеёжзийклмнопрстуфхцчшщъыьэюя
